brief: Check recurring-payment terms and retain evidence of a cancellation request.

title.es-MX: Revisa qué se repite y qué termina
title.pt-BR: Confira o que repete e o que termina

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Check what repeats and what stops"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Revisa qué se repite y qué termina"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Confira o que repete e o que termina"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Check recurring-payment terms and retain evidence of a cancellation request.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Read recurring charges and cancellation evidence as separate parts of a payment agreement.
instruction.misconception: Assuming deleting an app or stopping a payment automatically ends a service contract.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: Stopping an automatic payment may not end the service contract. Check both processes and keep confirmation of what ends when.
The starting price does not describe later recurring charges.
Use the stated process; lack of use is not its cancellation step.
The record states what was accepted and when it takes effect.
Changing payment instructions does not establish the contract’s status.
The confirmation helps identify what needs explanation or correction.
The annual term and renewal instruction are separate details.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
